description: A3 v2.1.1 on dev-v0.2: A3 v2.1 plus periods rules 1.1 (A2-numeric derived values take their window from their source XBRL facts; key-quote year references; historical vs forward-looking key quotes; review prompts 0.3) and API retries (bounded exponential backoff with jitter, Retry-After, at most 5 retries, never on 401). Same model, retrieval, token limits and budgets as v2.0 / v2.1; A2 unchanged; A3v2_1_1_RG replays A3v2_1_1_R from the cache. Evidence Reviewer max output tokens 4,096 (was 3,000; approved 2026-11-17 after reviews reached 2,940/3,000).
